mapper.select: SELECT id, item_code, initiation_id, standard_id, project_type, project_level, delivery_name, delivery_category, stage, required, planned_submit_date, actual_submit_date, accepted_date, submitter_id, submitter_name, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, review_comment, status, tr_required, tr_completed, file_ids, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_execution_delivery_item WHERE item_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
